name: Treasure Map
source: Fast & Furious only (it has no Treasure Map add-on, but the Treasure Map code of Forza Horizon 2 is still there): Xtra Options' TREASURE_MAP (features/unlocks, from Extra Options 0.4.4) found again by hand, the sites Fast & Furious keeps: the map's purchased-flag getters bound to the game's own 'return true' (0x886480), the barn-find marker check skipped, and a board-setup callback (in padding 0x40fca8) that marks every board it sets up as discovered; the map-check getter and the add-on store sites have no Fast & Furious counterpart
